name: sf-log-reader
description: Browse, fetch, and filter Salesforce debug logs from any authenticated org, surfaced in a bottom-panel webview.

sfLogReader.fetchLimit.description: Maximum number of recent logs to list/fetch per refresh.

sfLogReader.fetchConcurrency.description: How many log-body downloads to run in parallel. Higher = faster but more pressure on the org's API limits.

sfLogReader.autoTraceFlag.description: Before each fetch, automatically ensure a DEVELOPER_LOG TraceFlag is active for the current user so the org keeps writing debug logs. This creates a DebugLevel and TraceFlag on the org. Off by default — use the 'Start Capturing' toolbar button for a one-off instead.

sfLogReader.mermaidMaxEdges.description: Hard cap on edges emitted into the call-graph Mermaid block. Excess edges are dropped lowest-call-count first and a footnote is added. Also injected as the in-diagram maxEdges directive for renderers that honor it.

sfLogReader.mermaidMaxNodes.description: Hard cap on nodes (classes/triggers) emitted into the call-graph. Less-active nodes are dropped first.

sfLogReader.maxStorageMB.description: Soft cap on total local log storage (per org). When exceeded, a prompt offers to delete oldest logs.

sfLogReader.logFolderName.description: Where fetched logs and summaries are stored. Leave blank (default) to use the extension's private global storage, partitioned per workspace, so logs never appear in the workspace tree or git. Otherwise accepts a workspace-relative path, an absolute path, or '~' for the home directory.

sfLogReader.savedLogsFolder.description: Folder where 'Keep' copies logs for long-term reference. Leave blank (default) to use '~/sf-saved-logs'. Otherwise accepts a workspace-relative path, an absolute path, or '~' for the home directory. This folder is never touched by the storage cap cleanup.

sfLogReader.commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for individual sf CLI invocations and REST requests.

sfLogReader.apiVersion.description: Salesforce API version for direct Tooling API (REST) calls. Leave unset to use the org's default API version.
